claim: The scheduler couples a cosine LR warmup with a momentum schedule driven by coupling_alpha.
After warmup the momentum coefficient is a linear blend between momentum_floor and base_momentum, weighted by the LR cosine ratio and coupling_alpha.
Cosine learning-rate schedules without momentum coupling are a common training default.
On the internal benchmark, switching from constant momentum to the coupled schedule reduced top-1 error by ~0.4 points across two seeds.
